usage_constraints.mastery: Learning state ONLY. NEVER use for system status (use color.json system.* for that)
usage_constraints.confetti: ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG component. Whitelisted celebration moments only (see iron rule 3)
usage_constraints.streak_fire: ONLY for streak SVG icon (StreakBar molecule). Never as button color or background.
usage_constraints.motion: Celebration durations are independent from system motion (--tkn-motion-duration-*) to allow fine-tuning without affecting other transitions

forgot.comment: P08 '未掌握' button, P06/P09 forgot-node dot. Same hex as system-danger but DIFFERENT semantic namespace — meaning is 'I forgot' not 'system error'.

partial.comment: P08 '部分掌握' button, P06/P09 partial-node dot. Same hex as encouragement-DEFAULT — semantic alignment intentional ('still encouraging, almost there').

mastered.comment: P08 '已掌握' button, P06/P09 mastered-node dot, P09 celebration accent. Brighter / more friendly than system-success #1A7D34. Material Design mint.
mastered._warning: Below-AA for body text. Use as accent/background only.

confetti-1.comment: Gold particle (Apple Yellow). ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG.

confetti-2.comment: Pink particle (Apple Pink). ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG.

confetti-3.comment: Mint particle (Material Mint, same as mastery-mastered). ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG.

confetti-4.comment: Purple particle (Apple Indigo). ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG.

confetti-5.comment: Orange particle (Apple Orange). ONLY inside ConfettiBurst SVG.

fire.comment: Streak 🔥 icon fill (StreakBar molecule). Use SVG fill, NOT emoji. Distinct from encouragement-DEFAULT (#E8741C) — fire color is more saturated/red, evoking actual flame.
